local062.sql:
WITH customer_profits AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_id,
        SUM(s.quantity_sold * (co.unit_price - co.unit_cost)) AS total_profit
    FROM sales s
    JOIN costs co ON s.prod_id = co.prod_id 
        AND s.time_id = co.time_id 
        AND s.promo_id = co.promo_id 
        AND s.channel_id = co.channel_id
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52770
        AND s.time_id >= '2021-12-01' 
        AND s.time_id <= '2021-12-31'
    GROUP BY c.cust_id
),
stats AS (
    SELECT MIN(total_profit) AS min_p, MAX(total_profit) AS max_p FROM customer_profits
),
bucketed AS (
    SELECT 
        cp.cust_id,
        cp.total_profit,
        CASE 
            WHEN cp.total_profit = s.max_p THEN 10
            ELSE LEAST(10, FLOOR(1.0 * (cp.total_profit - s.min_p) / (s.max_p - s.min_p) * 10) + 1)
        END AS bucket
    FROM customer_profits cp, stats s
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS CUSTOMER_COUNT,
    MIN(total_profit) AS MIN_PROFIT_IN_BUCKET,
    MAX(total_profit) AS MAX_PROFIT_IN_BUCKET
FROM bucketed
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket

local096.sql:
WITH movie_actors AS (
    SELECT m.MID,
           CAST(SUBSTR(m.year, -4) AS INTEGER) as YEAR,
           COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(mc.PID)) as actor_count,
           MAX(CASE WHEN p.Gender = 'Male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_male,
           MAX(CASE WHEN p.Gender IS NULL OR p.Gender = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_unknown
    FROM Movie m
    LEFT JOIN M_Cast mc ON m.MID = mc.MID
    LEFT JOIN Person p ON TRIM(mc.PID) = p.PID
    GROUP BY m.MID, m.year
),
yearly_stats AS (
    SELECT YEAR,
           COUNT(*) as TOTAL_MOVIES,
           SUM(CASE WHEN actor_count > 0 AND has_male = 0 AND has_unknown = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as exclusively_female_count
    FROM movie_actors
    GROUP BY YEAR
)
SELECT YEAR,
       TOTAL_MOVIES,
       ROUND(100.0 * exclusively_female_count / TOTAL_MOVIES, 2) as PERCENTAGE_EXCLUSIVELY_FEMALE
FROM yearly_stats
ORDER BY YEAR
